description: This file defines the Ddos controller class for the Opencart admin fraud extension, handling UI rendering, saving settings, installation, uninstallation, and reporting of DDoS-related data.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Controller class for managing DDoS fraud detection settings and reports in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the DDoS configuration page with breadcrumbs, status, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of DDoS configuration settings via POST request.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the DDoS extension if user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the DDoS extension if user has permission.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a report of DDoS IPs with pagination and links to customer info.
